task.title: Configure Action Permissions for the Agreement Object

step.cmd: In the Conga Platform, select User Management from the top left menu.
Click Conga Platform Read Only Permission Group
Search for "Agreement" and click Set under the Action Permissions column.
Search for the action permission you want to enable. For example, DISPLAY CHECKIN RETAIN DOCUMENT NAME or DISPLAY CHECKIN CREATE PDF/A. Check the box beside the option.

note.p: You may have to browse through multiple pages of results depending on how many rows you have selected to display per page.
